claims.claim: The claimant must have been under State Pension age when their partner died.
claims.quote: When your partner died, you must have been: under State Pension age
claims.note: The source states the timing and age requirement.

claims.quote: The State Pension age for men and women will now increase to 67 between 2026 and 2028.
claims.note: The age varies by date of birth during the 2026–2028 transition and is not fixed at 66.

claims.claim: The deceased partner must have paid National Insurance contributions for at least 25 weeks unless the work-related death alternative applies.
claims.quote: A claimant is eligible if their partner either paid National Insurance contributions for at least 25 weeks or died due to an accident at work or disease caused by work.
claims.note: The source states the 25-week route and the alternative.

claims.claim: The qualifying contributions are Class 1 or Class 2 National Insurance contributions.
claims.quote: paid a certain amount of Class 1 or Class 2 National Insurance contributions in any one tax year since 6 April 1975
claims.note: The source names both contribution classes.

claims.claim: A deceased partner’s death from an accident at work or disease caused by work is an alternative qualifying route.
claims.quote: died because of an accident at work or a disease caused by work
claims.note: The source states the work-related death alternative.
